Name: Fried Green Tomatoes at the Whistle Stop Farm
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoGolf.gif[/img]
this is a new additional farm type originally based on my friend's commissioned farm but now is full of big tiered waterfalls [img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Reactions/Laugh/nukoHeadLaugh2.gif[/img]
biggest farm ive made yet actually :0

[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoForwardRoll.gif[/img]
Navigation:
[youtube]B7_KPXoNQbw[/youtube]

[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoOrchestra.gif[/img]
Features:
- a custom plantable farmcave with minecart system
- catchable mountain fishes no trash
- gravity defying waterfalls
- tillable grass
- swimmable lake and regenerates energy
- fireflies appear at night
- water
- earth
- fire
- air
[i]Long ago, the four nations lived together in harmony. Then, everything changed when the Fire Nation attacked. Only the Avatar, master of all four elements, could stop them, but when the world needed him most, he vanished. A hundred years passed and my brother and I discovered the new Avatar, an airbender named Aang. And although his airbending skills are great, he has a lot to learn before he's ready to save anyone. But I believe Aang can save the world[/i]
- you also get 5 strawberry seeds, 10 parsnip seeds, and a fish smoker as a starter gift :3

[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoBattledoreBadminton.gif[/img]
